scope: Persisted superadmin Workflow CRUD in API and Cloud, with tenant-admin denial for every generic CRUD operation.

environment.database: Separate disposable PostgreSQL 16.15 databases for API and Cloud on localhost.
environment.fixtures: Synthetic admin and superadmin accounts only; both registered with default role=user before isolated DB role preparation.
environment.network: Only local HTTP services and the isolated PostgreSQL cluster; no external integration or customer endpoint.

assertions_per_backend: Tenant admin received 403 for Workflow list, direct detail, create, update and delete routes.
Superadmin listed global Workflows and created a synthetic Workflow.
Superadmin read the new Workflow by ID and found it in the list.
Superadmin updated name and enabled state; a follow-up detail read returned both persisted values.
Superadmin deleted the Workflow; a follow-up global list no longer included it.
Authenticated API cleanup removed both temporary accounts; SQL verified zero UAT-077 accounts and Workflow rows.
limitations: This closes only the Workflow API rows for admin denial and superadmin CRUD; Web Workflow persistence and other roles, resources and surfaces remain open.
No live workflow execution or external integration was triggered.
